::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Bengaluru mm-wave fabless firm with strategic investment from Sansera Engineering; opened a new R&D facility in Bengaluru in 2024.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Millimetre-wave chips and subsystems for radar, 5G/6G communications and wireless connectivity.
